Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for taking our SIG and SOC 2 follow-up. As part of Nova Bank's vendor assessment we need a short evidence package covering business continuity and disaster recovery. To be specific, could you please provide the following by EOD next Tuesday (2026-12-14):

- RTO / RPO matrix for production services (per-service values and measurement method)
- High-level DR runbooks (primary recovery steps and RTO targets)
- Most recent DR test summary/artifacts (tabletop or failover tests from last 12 months)
- Backup retention policy and recent verification logs (last 10 days)
- Any compensating controls for data replication across regions

I've attached a short questionnaire to help map our SIG items to your controls (attachment: bcp-questionnaire-novabank-20261210.pdf). If anything above will take longer, please let me know what you can deliver and when. We may need one brief follow-up call to align on definitions for RTO measurement.

Appreciate your help — Nova Bank is on an accelerated procurement timeline so clarity here helps.

Best,
Alice Bennett

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a concise evidence pack and can deliver most items by your requested date. Quick notes / asks:

- RTO/RPO matrix: we'll provide a per-service sheet (rto-rpo-matrix.xlsx) showing target, achieved (measurement window), and responsible runbook.
- Runbooks: we'll include sanitized runbook summaries suitable for vendor sharing (runbook-recovery-summary.pdf). Full runbooks contain operational details we redact for security, but we can provide on a secure link under NDA if required.
- DR tests: we ran a partial failover exercise on 2026-07-15 and a table-top on 2026-11-02; we'll attach a summary and the test log extracts.
- Backups: backup verification logs (last 10 days) will be included as a compressed package (backup-verification-logs-20261130-20261209.tar.gz).

Two clarifications so we align on definitions:
1) For some services we use warm standby (RTO = 15m for frontend inference), for long-running batch jobs RTO is measured in hours. We'll call these out per-row in the matrix.
2) RPO is expressed as a target (e.g., <60s for KV cache, <24h for snapshots). Our measurement method column shows whether it's continuous replication checks or daily snapshot verification.

I'll upload the pack to a secure share and send a link by Monday morning. If you want a 30-minute sync to go over the matrix definitions, I'm available Mon/Tue 10–12 PT.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0169
